description: This source file defines classes and functions related to CUDA and Cutlass kernel generation within PyTorch's Torch Inductor backend. It includes abstractions for managing kernel layout, invoking CUDA kernels, and handling template-based kernel code generation, as well as interfaces for benchmark and code compilation workflows.

classes.name: CUDAKernel
classes.description: Base class for CUDA / Cutlass kernels, managing layout arguments and providing utility methods for kernel parameter handling.

classes.name: CUDATemplateKernel
classes.description: Represents a CUDA kernel defined through C++ templates, including methods for kernel signature generation and invocation.

classes.name: CUDATemplateCaller
classes.description: Represents a caller for CUDA template kernels, handling benchmarking, code generation, and resource management.

classes.name: LayoutArg
classes.description: Data class representing a layout argument used to specify tensor dimension mappings.

methods.name: int _normalize_idx(index: int, total_length: int)
methods.description: Normalizes an index, wrapping negative indices around with total length.

methods.name: Optional[str] find_symbol( self, node: IRNode, attr: ValidLayoutAttrs, dim: int )
methods.description: Finds the symbolic name associated with a layout argument for a specific node, attribute, and dimension.

methods.name: Optional[LayoutArg] find_layout_arg( self, node: IRNode, attr: ValidLayoutAttrs, dim: int )
methods.description: Finds the LayoutArg matching the specified node, attribute, and dimension.

methods.name: add_layout_arg( self, symbol: ValidLayoutSymbols, node: IRNode, attr: ValidLayoutAttrs, dim: int )
methods.description: Adds a new layout argument mapping for a given symbol, node, attribute, and dimension.

methods.name: None init_layout_args(self)
methods.description: Initializes layout arguments based on input tensors, setting up mappings for matrix dimensions and strides.

methods.name: tuple[Union[Expr,int],...] get_layout_args(self)
methods.description: Returns a tuple of the main layout-related shape and stride arguments.

methods.name: list[Union[Expr,int]] get_dynamic_shape_args(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of shape and stride arguments that may be dynamic.

methods.name: list[Expr] get_offset_args(self)

methods.name: int find_ld_idx(node: IRNode)
methods.description: Determines the index of the leading dimension for a tensor node.

methods.name: str check_not_null(self, node: IRNode)
methods.description: Generates code to check if a node is null and throws if so.

methods.name: str get_signature(self)
methods.description: Returns the kernel function signature.

methods.name: str def_kernel( self, inputs: list[IRNode], outputs: list[IRNode], names_str: str = "", input_reorder: Optional[list[int]] = None, )
methods.description: Defines the kernel function signature, parameters, and symbolic shapes.

methods.name: None call_kernel( self, name: str, node: "CUDATemplateBuffer", )
methods.description: Generates code to invoke the CUDA kernel with appropriate arguments, including workspace management.

methods.description: Returns the Cutlass dtype string for the tensor node's dtype.

methods.name: max_valid_index(self, node: IRNode, default=-1)
methods.description: Calculates the maximum valid index offset for a tensor node.

methods.name: str ptr(self, node: IRNode)

methods.name: str size( self, node: IRNode, start_index: int, end_index: Optional[int] = None, default_value: int = 0, )
methods.description: Generates code to compute the size of a tensor dimension or a slice thereof.

methods.name: str stride(self, node: IRNode, index: int, default_value: int = 0)
methods.description: Generates code for the stride of a tensor at a specific index.

methods.name: str batch_stride(self, node: IRNode, default_value: int = 0)
methods.description: Generates code for the batch stride (largest stride) of a tensor.

methods.name: str row_or_column_stride(self, node: IRNode, default_value: int = 0)
methods.description: Generates code for row or column stride, used in some CUTLASS APIs.

methods.description: Mock function to record a store operation for memory planning.

methods.description: Precompiles the benchmark request, preparing the kernel for execution.

methods.description: Runs a benchmark of the kernel execution, either profiling or standard.
